{{Top|leg}}
The '''Elesa Mining Union''' was a guild organized to protect the interest of miners in the town of [[Elesa]], capital of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. As most of the inhabitants were miners and the profits were scarce, the Union was an important organization, and was managed from the comparatively-luxurious [[Miner's Union Hall]].<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref>

At some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the Union's manager was bureaucrat [[Geon Justic]]. Justic was bribed by [[Ree]] to avoid problems with the local law while Ree and his partner [[Kaeline Ungasan]] performed an illegal mining operation of [[Vonium/Legends|Vonium]].<ref name="G2" />
